描述_EN: large and resilient, they were able to withstand the harsh conditions of the desert. a sogdian merchant is shown riding a double-humped camel. these camels were used for long-distance transportation along the routes of the silk road. the chinese used the double-humped bactrian camel for transporting goods and people.
描述_ZN: 大而有弹性，它们能够承受沙漠中的恶劣条件。 一个苏格拉底的商人骑着一头双峰骆驼。 这些骆驼被用于丝绸之路沿线的长途运输。 中国人用双峰双峰骆驼来运输货物和人员。
